parsed_json.up: Select distinct compound ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on tid. Filter by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4105860 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Require structures via INNER JOIN compound_structures. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
